name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: I recommend focusing on a clean and minimalistic design for the Mine AI website. This approach prioritizes user experience by reducing visual clutter, making it easier for visitors to navigate and understand our offerings. The trade-off here is that we might sacrifice some visual flair and distinctive branding elements that could make a stronger initial impact. However, clarity and usability are key in helping potential customers quickly grasp our value.

name: Squint
text: I'm not convinced that a clean and minimalistic design is the best approach for the Mine AI website, as it may come across as too bland and fail to differentiate us from other AI companies. A real risk here is that we might lose our unique identity and struggle to capture users' attention, so I think we should consider a more balanced design that incorporates some visually striking elements while still maintaining a user-friendly interface. To settle this, I'd like to see some concrete data on how minimalistic designs have performed for similar AI websites, as well as some alternative design concepts that we can test with our target audience.
